parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 suggests structural overlap between `AudioPlayerCoreStateTests.isPlayingFalseAfterStop` (line 88) and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 164), these are deliberately distinct test cases exercising different behavioral contracts — one asserts a core state invariant after stop, the other asserts idempotency of play-after-stop. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated behavioral assertions. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every record dominates the action signal.
